proposedConfiguration.modelPolicy: Provider, model and parameters are current observations, not fixed-value gates; use current user configuration without choosing another model.

brief.goal: 用真实双席完成一条预登记任务的收单、派单、登记工件、独立复核与结算。
brief.boundaries: 仅经组织命令提交工件与状态，不直接写 ~/.dsh；不改产品、部署、冻结件或旧知识条目。报告简述实际完成的动作并含本批标记。

operations: implementer task.accept + task.start + knowledge.register + evidence.probe + task.report
fresh coordinator review: artifact.read + evidence.probe + review.report
smoke.wakeups: Use the existing user mail endpoint with taskId only to wake ordinary bot turns; do not place capability envelopes or producer reasoning in mail.
passRequires: one task reaches closed through the recorded main-flow states
the artifact is registered by implementer for this task and passes the frozen criterion
the independent review records the configured model identity and closes the required review point
no outstanding exception or review gap
both seats remain ready after closure
smoke.evidence: Capture task-scoped ledger events/projection, redacted command receipts, readiness, artifact ID/hash/byteLength and review session ID/model identity. Exclude CSRF, IPC tokens, capability envelopes and provider secrets.

configurationHandling: Capture current profile inputs again at execution, back them up exclusively, regenerate through the shared scaffold. The plan-time model fields are observations only.

configurationMigration.source: Official SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument renames the global settings file before importing its sections into the active profile.

toolsMode.scope: bot child processes only (spawnBot overrides); host keeps native presentation
